directoryAdminUi.title: Public listing
directoryAdminUi.subtitle: Let patients find you on AltCare. You choose what is shown, and you can turn the listing off at any time.
directoryAdminUi.loadFailed: Could not load your listing. Please refresh the page.

status.liveText: Patients can find you in the AltCare directory.
status.notLiveTitle: Your profile is not public yet
status.notLiveText: A listing goes public only when all five steps below are done.

not_listed.label: Listing turned on
not_listed.fix: Turn on "Show me in the public directory" below and save.

not_verified.label: Credentials verified by AltCare
not_verified.fix: An AltCare admin reviews your registration. Make sure your registration body and number are filled in under Profile and Settings. Verification is free.

not_approved.label: Clinic approved
not_approved.fix: Your clinic account is waiting for approval by AltCare. You do not need to do anything.

not_in_plan.label: Plan includes the listing
not_in_plan.fix: The listing is included in the Plus and Pro plans.

no_profile_text.label: Profile text added
no_profile_text.fix: Write a short bio (in English or Bangla) below and save.

status.paymentNote: Paying for a plan does not replace verification. Both are needed.

stats.title: This month
stats.hint: Counted from the public listing since the start of the month. Zero is normal until your profile is public.

form.title: Your listing
form.enable: Show me in the public directory
form.enableHint: When off, nobody can see your profile, even if everything else is ready.
form.headline: Headline
form.headlineHint: One line about you, for example "Homeopath for chronic and skin conditions". Up to {max} characters.
form.bioHint: Required for the listing. Describe your training, approach and the conditions you see most. Up to {max} characters. Avoid promises of cure.
form.languagesHint: Separate with commas, for example: Bangla, English. Up to {max}.
form.hoursHint: Short text, for example "Sat-Thu 5 pm to 9 pm".
form.privacy: What patients can see and do
form.showFeeHint: Shows the consultation and follow-up fee from your clinic settings.
form.showPhoneHint: Patients can tap to call your clinic phone. Taps are counted.
form.showWhatsappHint: Patients can tap to message you on WhatsApp. Taps are counted.
form.acceptsRequestsHint: Patients can leave their name and number. You get an email and see it below.
form.alwaysShown: Always shown when you are listed
form.alwaysShownText: Your name, qualifications, registration body and clinic address come from your Profile and Settings. Your registration number is never shown.
form.tooManyLanguages: You can list at most {max} languages.

requests.title: Call-back requests
requests.subtitle: Patients who asked you to call them. This is personal information: use it only to contact the patient about their request.
requests.emptyAll: No requests yet. They will appear here when patients ask for a call back.

verification.title: Credential verification
verification.description: Record that you checked this doctor's registration and credentials. Free for every plan. Required before the clinic can appear in the public directory.
verification.noteMissing: Not shown here. The clinic detail data does not include the note or the date unless you just changed it in this session.
verification.detailsMissing: Registration body and number, license number, years of experience and degrees are not part of this page's data yet. Check them in the doctor's records before verifying.
verification.notePlaceholder: For example: BHMS certificate and Board registration checked
